description: 基于工艺过程描述，通过建立尺寸链方程，计算中间工序尺寸及其上下偏差。
example_json: {"inputs": {"closed_loop_basic_size": 43.6, "closed_loop_tolerance": 0.34, "known_component_basic_sizes": [20.0, 0.2], "known_component_tolerances": [0.025, 0.075], "known_component_deviations": {"R1": {"upper": 0.025, "lower": 0}, "A": {"upper": 0.025, "lower": -0.05}}}, "expected_output": {"unknown_component_basic_size": 43.4, "unknown_component_upper_deviation": 0.315, "unknown_component_lower_deviation": 0.05}, "source": "页面右侧计算过程及最终结果 B = 43.45 (+0.265/0) mm"}
formula:
1. 平均公差: T_av,L = T_0 / 3
2. 组成环公差: T_A = T_R1 + T_R; T_B = T_B1 - T_R1 - T_R
3. 上偏差(ES): ES_B1 = ES_B + ES_A => ES_B = ES_B1 - ES_A; ES_B1 = EI_R1 - ES_R
4. 下偏差(EI): EI_B1 = EI_B + EI_A => EI_B = EI_B1 - EI_A; EI_B1 = ES_R1 - EI_R
5. 基本尺寸: B = B1 - A
inputs_json: [{"name": "closed_loop_basic_size", "type": "float", "unit": "mm", "description": "封闭环基本尺寸 (L0/B1)"}, {"name": "closed_loop_tolerance", "type": "float", "unit": "mm", "description": "封闭环总公差 (T0)"}, {"name": "known_component_basic_sizes", "type": "list", "unit": "mm", "description": "已知组成环的基本尺寸列表 (R1, A)"}, {"name": "known_component_tolerances", "type": "list", "unit": "mm", "description": "已知组成环的公差列表"}, {"name": "known_component_deviations", "type": "dict", "unit": "mm", "description": "已知组成环的上下偏差字典"}]
outputs_json: [{"name": "unknown_component_basic_size", "type": "float", "unit": "mm", "description": "待求工序尺寸基本尺寸 (B)"}, {"name": "unknown_component_upper_deviation", "type": "float", "unit": "mm", "description": "待求工序尺寸上偏差 (ES_B)"}, {"name": "unknown_component_lower_deviation", "type": "float", "unit": "mm", "description": "待求工序尺寸下偏差 (EI_B)"}]
